Arguments\n910\t    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n911\t    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n912\t    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n913\t    ///\n914\t    /// # Returns\n915\t    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n916\t    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n917\t        &self,\n918\t        root_id: &str,\n919\t        direction: &str,\n920\t        max_depth: usize,\n921\t    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n922\t        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n923\t\n924\t        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n925\t        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n926\t            \"up\" => {\n927\t                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n928\t                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n929\t                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n930\t                (\n931\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n932\t                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n933\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n934\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n935\t                )\n936\t            }\n937\t            _ => {\n938\t                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n939\t                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n940\t                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n941\t                (\n942\t                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n943\t                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n944\t                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n945\t                    \"d.issue_id\",\n946\t                )\n947\t            }\n948\t        };\n949\t\n950\t        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n951\t            String::new()\n952\t        } else {\n953\t            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n954\t        };\n955\t\n956\t        let sql = format!(\n957\t            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n958\t                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n959\t                SELECT\n960\t                    {id_col} as id,\n961\t                    i.title,\n962\t                    i.status,\n963\t                    i.priority,\n964\t                    0 as depth,\n965\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n966\t                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n967\t                FROM dependencies d\n968\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n969\t                WHERE {anchor_join}\n970\t\n971\t                UNION ALL\n972\t\n973\t                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n974\t                SELECT\n975\t                    {id_col} as id,\n976\t                    i.title,\n977\t                    i.status,\n978\t                    i.priority,\n979\t                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n980\t                    d.type as dep_type,\n981\t                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n982\t                FROM dependencies d\n983\t                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n984\t                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n985\t                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n986\t                {depth_limit}\n987\t            )\n988\t            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n989\t            FROM dep_tree\n990\t            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n991\t        );\n992\t\n993\t        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n994\t        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n995\t        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n996\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n997\t            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n998\t            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n999\t            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n1000\t            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n1001\t\n1002\t            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n1003\t                id: row.get(0)?,\n1004\t                title: row.get(1)?,\n1005\t                status: row.get(2)?,\n1006\t                priority: row.get(3)?,\n1007\t                depth: row.get(4)?,\n1008\t                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n1009\t                path: if is_cycle {\n1010\t                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n1011\t                } else {\n1012\t                    path\n1013\t                },\n1014\t            });\n1015\t        }\n1016\t        Ok(nodes)\n1017\t self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n            match conn.query_row(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                params![id],\n                |_| Ok(true),\n            ) {\n                Ok(result) => result,\n                Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => false,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n            }\n        };\n        if !exists {\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n        }\n\n        // Scan for secrets before updating (only for string fields in changes)\n        if let Some(scanner) = &*self.secret_scanner.lock().unwrap() {\n            let mut all_matches = Vec::new();\n            for field in [\n                changes.title.as_deref(),\n                changes.description.as_deref(),\n                changes.design.as_deref(),\n                changes.acceptance_criteria.as_deref(),\n                changes.notes.as_deref(),\n                changes.assignee.as_deref(),\n                changes.owner.as_deref(),\n                changes.external_ref.as_deref(),\n            ] {\n                if let Some(value) = field {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(labels) = &changes.labels {\n                for label in labels {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(label));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(annotations) = &changes.annotations {\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(key));\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if !all_matches.is_empty() {\n                return Err(SecretError(format_secret_matches(&all_matches)).into());\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let mut updates = Vec::new();\n            let mut params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = Vec::new();\n            if let Some(ref title) = changes.title {\n                updates.push(\"title = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(title.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref description) = changes.description {\n                updates.push(\"description = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(description.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref design) = changes.design {\n                updates.push(\"design = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(design.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref acceptance_criteria) = changes.acceptance_criteria {\n                updates.push(\"acceptance_criteria = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(acceptance_criteria.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref notes) = changes.notes {\n                updates.push(\"notes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(notes.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref status) = changes.status {\n                updates.push(\"status = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(status.to_string()));\n                // Clear closed fields when transitioning from closed/tombstone to open\n                if !matches!(status, Status::Closed | Status::Tombstone) {\n                    updates.push(\"closed_at = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"close_reason = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"closed_by_session = NULL\");\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(priority) = changes.priority {\n                updates.push(\"priority = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(priority));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref issue_type) = changes.issue_type {\n                updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(issue_type.to_string()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                updates.push(\"assignee = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(assignee.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref owner) = changes.owner {\n                updates.push(\"owner = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(estimated_minutes) = changes.estimated_minutes {\n                updates.push(\"estimated_minutes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(estimated_minutes));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref due_at) = changes.due_at {\n                updates.push(\"due_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(due_at.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref defer_until) = changes.defer_until {\n                updates.push(\"defer_until = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(defer_until.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref external_ref) = changes.external_ref {\n                updates.push(\"external_ref = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(external_ref.clone()));\n            }\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            if !updates.is_empty() {\n                updates.push(\"updated_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(now.to_rfc3339()));\n                let query = format!(\"UPDATE issues SET {} WHERE id = ?\", updates.join(\", \"));\n                let mut all_params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = params.into_iter().collect();\n                all_params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()));\n                let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n                    all_params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n                tx.execute(&query, param_refs.as_slice())?;\n            }\n            // Handle label updates separately\n            if let Some(ref labels) = changes.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![id])?;\n                for label in labels {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![id, label],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle annotation updates separately\n            if let Some(ref annotations) = changes.annotations {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = ? params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn count_issues(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n    match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                Some(ref val) if val.is_empty() => Ok(None),\n                Some(val) => Ok(Some(parse_datetime(val)?)),\n            }\n        };\n        let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        Ok(Issue {\n            content_hash: row.get(1)?,\n            title: row.get(2)?,\n            description: row.get(3)?,\n            design: row.get(4)?,\n            acceptance_criteria: delete_reason: row.get(26)?,\n            original_type: row.get(27)?,\n            compaction_level: row.get(28)?,\n            compacted_at: parse_opt_dt(29)?,\n            compacted_at_commit:       is_template: row.get::<_, i32>(35)? != 0,\n            labels: Self::load_labels_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            dependencies: Self::load_dependencies_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            comments: = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            labels.push(row.get(0)?);\n        }\n        Ok(labels)\n    }\n\n    fn load_dependencies_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id:      .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n   Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type:       assignee: Option<&str>,\n        labels: &[String],\n        priority_min: Option<i32>,\n        priority_max: Option<i32>,\n        limit: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\",\n                param_idx,\n                param_idx + 1\n            ));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels\n                .iter()\n                .enumerate()\n                .map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i))\n                .collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n            params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM }\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n    ///\n    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    ///\n    /// When model and harness are provided, uses velocity-aware scoring:\n    /// - LEFT JOINs velocity_stats on (issue_type, model, harness)\n    /// - Returns expected_seconds and combined_score for velocity-adjusted comparison\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(\n        &self,\n        model: Option<&str>,\n        harness: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        if let (Some(m), Some(h)) = (model, harness) {\n            // Velocity-aware scoring: join velocity_stats and compute combined_score\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts,\n                        vs.p50_seconds as expected_seconds,\n                        (COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n                         + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n                         + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)) as combined_score\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n                     AND vs.model = ?1\n                     AND vs.harness = ?2\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     combined_score / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC,\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    row.get(0)?,\n                    row.get(1)?,\n                    row.get(2)?,\n                    row.get(3)?,\n                    row.get(4)?,\n                    row.get(5)?,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Standard scoring without velocity data\n            let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n                \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                        COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                        i.priority,\n                        CAST(strftime('%s', i.created_at) AS INTEGER) as created_ts\n                 FROM issues i\n                 LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n                 WHERE i.status = 'open'\n                   AND i.ephemeral = 0\n                   AND i.pinned = 0\n                   AND i.is_template = 0\n                   AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n                   AND NOT EXISTS (\n                       SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                       INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                       WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                       AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                       AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n                   )\n                 GROUP BY i.id\n                 ORDER BY\n                     downstream_impact DESC,\n                     critical_float ASC,\n                     i.priority ASC,\n                     i.created_at ASC\n                 LIMIT 1\",\n            )?;\n\n            let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let downstream_impact: i64 = row.get(0)?;\n                let critical_float: i64 = row.get(1)?;\n                let priority: i32 = row.get(2)?;\n                let created_at_ts: i64 = row.get(3)?;\n\n                // Compute combined_score for consistency\n                let combined_score = downstream_impact as f64 * 3.0\n                    + (4 - priority) as f64 * 2.0\n                    + 1000.0 / (critical_float as f64 + 1.0);\n\n                Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score::new(\n                    downstream_impact,\n                    critical_float,\n                    priority,\n                    created_at_ts,\n                    None, // No expected_seconds without velocity data\n                    combined_score,\n                )))\n            } else {\n                Ok(None)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker session for tracking metadata.\n    ///\n    /// Stores worker metadata (model, harness, version) for each {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    acceptance_criteria: Option<String>,\n    notes: Option<String>,\n    design: Option<String>,\n    due_at: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    // Parse due_at if provided\n    let due_at_parsed = match due_at {\n        Some(date_str) => {\n            let dt = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&date_str)\n                .map_err(|_| anyhow!(\"Invalid --due-at format. Use RFC3339 format, e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\"))?;\n            Some(dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        title,\n        status: status.map(|s| Status::from_str(&s).ok()).flatten(),\n        priority,\n        assignee,\n        description,\n        acceptance_criteria,\n        notes,\n        design,\n        due_at: due_at_parsed,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &changes)?;\n    println!(\"Updated bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_close(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // --limit 0 means unlimited (get_ready_candidates omits LIMIT clause when limit == 0)\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Output as JSON array: [] for empty, [candidate] for single, [c1, c2, ...] for multiple\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidates)?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage\n                            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates =\n                storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))?;\n            candidates\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c))\n                .collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) =                  }\n                    if result.missing_in_jsonl.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_jsonl.len() - 10);\n                    }\n      println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.hash_mismatch.is_empty() {\n         }\n                    if result.hash_mismatch.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.hash_mismatch.len() - 10);\n                    }\n    };\n\n    println!(\"{}\", count);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_batch(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    json: Option<String>,\n    stdin: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir:                  print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n Worker performance tracking and velocity-aware claim scoring.\n//!\n//! This module tracks how long workers take to complete beads based on their\n//! (model, harness, issue_type) configuration and uses this data to inform\n//! claim scoring.\n//!\n//! ## Data Flow\n//!\n//! 1. When a bead is claimed, `worker_sessions` row is created (in claim.rs)\n//! 2. When a bead is closed, the session is updated with `closed_at` and `duration_seconds`\n//! 3. Velocity stats are recomputed from the last 50 sessions per (model, harness, issue_type)\n//! 4. Claim scoring uses expected_seconds from velocity_stats: score = impact / expected_seconds\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse rusqlite::{params, Connection, OptionalExtension};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\n/// Velocity statistics for a (model, harness, issue_type) tuple.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct VelocityStats {\n    pub model: String,\n    pub harness: String,\n    pub issue_type: String,\n    pub sample_count: i64,\n    pub p50_seconds: Option<i64>,\n    pub p90_seconds: Option<i64>,\n    pub avg_seconds: Option<f64>,\n    pub last_updated: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Worker session record from worker_sessions table.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct WorkerSession {\n    pub worker_id: String,\n    pub model: Option<String>,\n    pub harness: Option<String>,\n    pub harness_version: Option<String>,\n    pub claimed_at: String,\n    pub bead_id: Option<String>,\n    pub workspace_path: String,\n    pub closed_at: Option<String>,\n    pub duration_seconds: Option<i64>,\n}\n\n/// Update a worker session with close time and duration.\n///\n/// Called when a bead is closed. Finds the most recent claim session for the bead\n/// and updates it with closed_at and duration_seconds.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n/// * `bead_id` - The bead that was closed\n/// * `closed_at` - When the bead was closed\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(true)` if a session was found and updated\n/// * `Ok(false)` if no matching session was found\npub fn update_session_on_close(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    bead_id: &str,\n    closed_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n) -> Result<bool> {\n    // Find the most recent session for this bead\n    let session = tx\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT ws.claimed_at, ws.model, ws.harness, i.issue_type\n             FROM worker_sessions ws\n             INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = ws.bead_id\n             WHERE ws.bead_id = ?1\n             ORDER BY ws.claimed_at DESC\n             LIMIT 1\",\n            params![bead_id],\n            |row| {\n                let claimed_at: String = row.get(0)?;\n                let model: Option<String> = row.get(1)?;\n                let harness: Option<String> = row.get(2)?;\n                let issue_type: Option<String> = row.get(3)?;\n                Ok((claimed_at, model, harness, issue_type))\n            },\n        )\n        .optional()?;\n\n    let (claimed_at_str, model, harness, issue_type): (\n        String,\n        Option<String>,\n        Option<String>,\n        Option<String>,\n    ) = match session {\n        None => return Ok(false), // No worker session exists for this bead\n        Some(s) => s,\n    };\n\n    // Parse claimed_at and calculate duration\n    let claimed_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&claimed_at_str)\n        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Invalid claimed_at format: {}\", e))?\n        .with_timezone(&Utc);\n\n    let duration_seconds = closed_at.signed_duration_since(claimed_at).num_seconds();\n\n    // Update the session with closed_at and duration_seconds\n    let rows_updated = Ok(true)\n    } else {\n        Ok(false)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Recompute velocity statistics for a given (model, harness, issue_type) tuple.\n///\n/// Queries the last 50 completed sessions for the tuple `issue_type` - The issue type\nfn recompute_velocity_stats(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    model: &str,\n    harness: &str,\n    issue_type: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Get last 50 completed sessions for this tuple\n    let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n        \"SELECT duration_seconds\n         FROM worker_sessions ws\n         INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = ws.bead_id\n         WHERE ws.model = ?1\n           AND ws.harness = ?2\n           AND i.issue_type = ?3\n           AND ws.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL\n         ORDER BY ws.closed_at DESC\n         LIMIT 50\",\n    )?;\n\n    let mut durations: Vec<i64> = stmt\n        .query_map(params![model, harness, issue_type], |row| row.get(0))?\n        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n    let sample_count = durations.len() as i64;\n    let (p50_seconds, p90_seconds, avg_seconds) = if durations.is_empty() {\n        (None, None, None)\n    } else {\n        durations.sort_unstable();\n        let len = durations.len();\n\n        // Calculate percentiles\n        let p50_idx = (len as f64 * 0.5).floor() as usize;\n        let p90_idx = (len as f64 * 0.9).floor() as usize;\n        let p50 = Some(durations[p50_idx]);\n        let p90 = if len > 1 {\n            Some(durations[p90_idx])\n        } else {\n            p50\n        };\n\n        // Calculate average\n        let sum: i64 = durations.iter().sum();\n        let avg = Some(sum as f64 / len as f64);\n\n        (p50, p90, avg)\n    };\n\n    // Upsert into velocity_stats\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO velocity_stats (model, harness, issue_type, sample_count, p50_seconds, p90_seconds, avg_seconds, last_updated)\n         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)\",\n        params![\n            model,\n            harness,\n            issue_type,\n            sample_count,\n            p50_seconds,\n            p90_seconds,\n            avg_seconds,\n            Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n        ],\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Get expected duration in seconds for a (model, harness, issue_type) tuple.\n///\n/// Returns the p50 (median) duration if available, otherwise None.\n///\n///
